set_current_user: set the current authenticated user in the async task context for repository isolation
reset_current_user: reset the current user context to its previous state using the stored token
get_current_user: get the current authenticated user from the context or return None if unset
require_current_user: require the current authenticated user from context or raise a RuntimeError if unset
get_effective_user_id: get the current user id string or return the default user id for filesystem paths
